subject: SIG / CAIQ evidence request — SCIM delta & SAML assertion samples
messages:
From: Sara Chen <sara.chen@novafarm.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novafarm.com
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG / CAIQ: access control evidence request (SCIM, SAML, RBAC)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this — our security team is compiling the SIG/CAIQ response for our board review and we need a focused access control packet from Redwood covering SSO/SAML, SCIM syncs, and evidence of least-privilege role mappings. Specifically we need: 

- SAML assertion samples (full headers) for 3 recent login events (timestamps + audience + NameID)
- SCIM delta export for the last 90 days (or a sample showing create/update/delete flows)
- A role matrix that maps Redwood roles to minimum privileges and the owners for each role
- A short note on how service accounts and delegated permissions are handled (rotation, scoping)

Can you confirm what you can provide by next Friday, 2028-03-08? We may need redacted identifiers for PII — fine with that as long as we can validate timestamps and claim values.

Also include any recommended contact for follow-up technical questions (we may loop in our IdP vendor).

Thanks,
Sara Chen
Security Program Manager
Novafarm Therapeutics

Attachments: none (requesting artifacts)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Sara Chen <sara.chen@novafarm.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 13:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ: access control evidence request (SCIM, SAML, RBAC)

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear breakdown. We're happy to assemble the packet. Quick confirmations so we scope delivery properly: 

1) Redaction: we can provide fully redacted UPNs and UUIDs but will preserve timestamps, assertion audiences, NameID hashes, and attribute names. Is that acceptable?
2) SCIM: do you need a full 90-day raw dump or would a compressed delta sample (create/update/delete with before/after) plus a change-rate summary suffice for SIG?
3) Service accounts: we'll include rotation windows and the least-privilege assignment table. Do you want key rotation logs included or just the policy + last-rotation timestamps?

Planned timeline:
- Draft packet (redacted artifacts + role matrix): by 2028-03-02 (internal review)
- Final delivery (zipped evidence + delivery note): by 2028-03-07

Jonas (security) and Mina (solutions) are cc'd — Jonas will own the SAML/SCIM samples, Mina will own the role mapping and customer-facing narrative. If Novafarm's IdP (Okta/Azure AD) needs an assertion sample in a specific format, let us know.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed filename list (we will attach the artifacts in the final zip)
From: Sara Chen <sara.chen@novafarm.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novafarm.com
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG / CAIQ: access control evidence request (SCIM, SAML, RBAC)

Kimberly — thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Redaction is fine but we need the NameID and NameIDFormat preserved (you can hash values as long as it's stable across samples).
- For SCIM, a delta sample + change-rate summary works. Please include one example where an attribute mapping changed (role assignment) and had downstream effect (service access revoked).
- Service accounts: please include last-rotation timestamps and the owner for each account we send. We do not need raw secrets/logs.

Also can you add a short runbook paragraph (1–2 bullets) describing how Redwood handles emergency privilege elevation and rollback? Our audit team will verify process controls.

If possible, upload the draft packet to the HubSpot deal record (DEAL-9142) or share a secure Drive folder. We may ask a few technical follow-ups once we review. New target: can you get a draft to us by 2028-03-02 EOD?

Appreciate it — looping procurement in so they track the request.

—Sara
